lines.text: *Flash*
A series of lights suddenly illuminate the dark space.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: What the...

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: This must be some kind of underground facility.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Apparently.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Where does it connect to?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: There's no way to know.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Hmm... all right. Stay here for a moment.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: I'll go check it out.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Where are you going?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Don't worry, I'm a jack of all trades. The only thing I can't really do is repairs.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Then you're not a jack of all trades.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: ... Why do you always have a way of finding the pettiest quibbles?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Anyway, this almost certainly isn't a Rapture facility.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: I'll go see if I can find someone to fix you.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: The reports say that there aren't any humans left on the surface.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: There's no way you'll find someone who can help.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: So do you want to sit around here and do nothing instead?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Even if there aren't any people, I might find some supplies.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: I'll be back, so be patient and wait here.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Unless you want me to carry you?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: I'll wait.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Good, good. Even though it's unlikely, if anything happens while I'm gone, just... hmm...

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Call out for me,

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: and I'll come running.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Just make sure the cat doesn't get your tongue like it did a few moments ago, all right?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: ... Okay.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: All right, I'll be back.
Red Hood walks off resolutely.
Meanwhile, Rapi watches her from behind, somewhat dazed.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: I don't even know what I'm saying...
Red Hood continues to walk down an ominous corridor.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Ugh... I hate these kinds of places. They give me the creeps.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Some music would work wonders for this joint.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: ... It's a door.
A massive iron door blocks Red Hood's path.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Jeez, what's up with this thing? It's gotta be at least 10 meters tall.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Wonder if I can break through it?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Guess there's only one way to find out.
Red Hood aims her rifle at the towering door.
*Psshuuuuu*
Just as she's about to pull the trigger, steam billows from all sides of the door as it slowly opens.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Should I consider that a welcome?
Red Hood heads in through the doorway.
Inside, it's both dark and warm.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: What a weird place.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Hello? Is anybody here?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Yes. Be quiet, will you? I hate noise.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Gah! You scared me!

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Is that Red Hood?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: ... Do you know me?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Of course I do.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: I am, no... we are D.E.E.P.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: How to refer to us...

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: I suppose it would be apt to consider us guardians of the Ark.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Guardians of the Ark?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: I'm afraid I can't tell you much more than that.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: It's classified.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Let me guess: Central Government?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: No. I would appreciate it if you thought of us as something more sophisticated.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Okay, I will.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Much appreciated.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: So, do you run this place?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: You could say that, yes.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: What is this place?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: It is the basement of the Lift.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: This is where the power source of the Lift is located.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: No way!

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Would you like to see?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: It's right here.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Wait a minute...

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Is that... a Rapture core?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Correct. It is called the Ultra Massive Core.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Not the most creative name out there.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: I don't like it either.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: So, if this thing broke, would the Lift be kaput?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Correct. It would no longer be operational.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: This thing is what the Raptures use to come down to our world, isn't it?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: You are well informed.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Then isn't breaking this thing the answer to all our problems?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: If you are referring to the Raptures, you are correct.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: So let's start busting this thing up.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: No. We cannot.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: The Ultra Massive Core is part of a pair.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: If one breaks, the other will break as well.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Right now, they are maintaining a stable resonance with one another from a distance.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Why does that matter? Who cares if they both break?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: The other core is inside the Ark.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: It is being used as the Ark's power source.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: So you're saying...

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: If you destroy this core, the Ark's core will be destroyed as well.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: All those people will be trapped underground. All of their infrastructure will cease to function in an instant, they will be doomed to die.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Humanity will be wiped out.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: ... I'm not entirely sure I follow.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: In the near future, this area will be further fortified.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: It will not be possible for anyone to trespass upon this place, by accident or otherwise, as you have.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: If you wish to

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: exterminate the Raptures,

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: the Ark must be sacrificed.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Sacrifice the Ark...?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Destroying this core will eradicate the Raptures, yes.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: But humanity will also perish.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Ironically, the key to victory may well lie in finding a way to abandon the Ark.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Although, I am not sure if that will be possible.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: We can win... if we destroy the Ark.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: How do you know who I am?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: It would be rather strange for me not to be familiar with the Goddess Squad.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: I thought you had been disposed of due to corruption, but it appears I was mistaken.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: You do still seem to be affected by corruption, however.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: You're good. Are you a doctor?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: More or less.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: But it is rather peculiar.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Decades have passed, and yet you are still alive? How is that possible?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Who knows. Maybe I'm just built differently.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Are you attempting to heal your comrade who fell through the fissure?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: That's right. You were watching everything?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: This is an important place. I see everything. Since it is you, I'll let you live.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Were you anyone else, you would already be dead.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: ... Sounds like you have experience with this sort of thing.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: That I do. At least a few dozen times.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Let's go. I can fix a broken leg rather easily.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: ... All right. Thanks.
Red Hood stares at the Ultra Massive Core behind her for a brief moment before walking away.
Red Hood and D.E.E.P. look at Rapi, who is asleep.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Hey. Rapi. I brought someone to fix...

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Quiet.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Nothing good will come out of her seeing me.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Then what about me?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: You do not have long left to live, so it doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: ... You certainly don't sugarcoat anything.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Let me check on your friend's condition.
D.E.E.P. squats down and examines Rapi,
placing her hands on Rapi's head and chest.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: This is a mass-produced model.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: My goodness, there's really nothing inside her. Frankly, I'm stunned at how little there is.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Are you talking about her chest? I mean, sure, she's flat, but I don't think it's that ba...

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Quiet.
D.E.E.P. goes silent, seemingly deep in thought.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: I haven't worked on either mass-produced models or Grimms models before.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: This could be a good opportunity.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: You aren't going to fix her?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: With the twin cores, the only outcome is mutually assured destruction.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: We have to leave the possibility of coexistence open.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Sleep for a while.
*Crack*
A golden light bursts from D.E.E.P.'s hand.
Red Hood loses consciousness and collapses to the ground.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Perhaps I should take a look at the corruption's progression. I might be able to help.
D.E.E.P. places her hand on Red Hood's head.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: ... No. Not possible. It's too far along.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: However, the NIMPH is continuing to fight despite the corruption. Eventually, they will both destroy one another.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: Having said that, she possesses a most incredible will. It's hard to believe.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: It's a miracle that she's endured as long as she has.

lines.speaker: deep
lines.text: It is a pity we did not meet sooner.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Are you awake?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: *Gasp*!

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: What the... When did I fall asleep?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: I just woke up too.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Wha...

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Right! Your leg!

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: What are you so frantic for? Didn't you fix it for me?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Huh?
Red Hood stares at Rapi's leg. It is fully intact, with no trace of any damage.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Huh? When did that happen?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: How would I know? I was unconscious.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: My head feels kinda funny...

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Ah, I get it!

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: I must have instinctively mastered the art of repairing!

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: I told you I was a jack of all trades!

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: ... Right.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: I think so too.
